name: refactor_sh_dedupe_functions
description: Consolidates two copy-pasted backup functions into one parameterized helper
prompts: backup_dirs.sh contains backup_config and backup_data - identical 10-line bodies except for the directory name. Refactor it (POSIX sh) into ONE parameterized function, e.g. backup_dir <name>, called once per directory. Behavior must stay identical: same archive paths (backups/<name>-<stamp>.tar.gz), same 'backed up:' lines on stdout, same 'skip: <name> missing' to stderr with the script still exiting 0 when a directory doesn't exist.

setup_files.backup_dirs.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# backup_dirs.sh: tar up the config and data directories with a timestamp.

stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d)

backup_config() {
    src="config"
    dest="backups/config-$stamp.tar.gz"
    mkdir -p backups
    if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
        echo "skip: $src missing" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    tar -czf "$dest" "$src"
    echo "backed up: $dest"
}

backup_data() {
    src="data"
    dest="backups/data-$stamp.tar.gz"
    mkdir -p backups
    if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
        echo "skip: $src missing" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    tar -czf "$dest" "$src"
    echo "backed up: $dest"
}

backup_config
backup_data
exit 0

test_setup_files.test_backup.py:
import os, re, subprocess, tarfile

os.makedirs('config', exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs('data', exist_ok=True)
open('config/app.conf', 'w').write('k=v')
open('data/rows.csv', 'w').write('1,2')

r = subprocess.run(['sh', 'backup_dirs.sh'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'exit {r.returncode}: {r.stderr}'
lines = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('backed up: ')]
assert len(lines) == 2, f'expected 2 backed up lines: {r.stdout!r}'
archives = sorted(os.listdir('backups'))
assert len(archives) == 2, archives
assert re.match(r'config-\d{8}\.tar\.gz', archives[0]), archives
assert re.match(r'data-\d{8}\.tar\.gz', archives[1]), archives
with tarfile.open(f'backups/{archives[0]}') as t:
    assert any(m.name.endswith('app.conf') for m in t.getmembers())

# missing dir: skip to stderr, still exit 0
os.rename('data', 'data-moved')
r2 = subprocess.run(['sh', 'backup_dirs.sh'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
assert r2.returncode == 0, f'missing dir must not fail the script: {r2.returncode}'
assert 'skip: data missing' in r2.stderr, r2.stderr

# consolidation: the tar invocation must appear exactly once in the source
src = open('backup_dirs.sh').read()
assert src.count('tar -czf') <= 1, 'tar invocation still duplicated'
assert src.count('skip:') <= 1, 'skip message still duplicated'
print('PASS')

backup_dir() {
    src=$1
    dest="backups/$src-$stamp.tar.gz"
    mkdir -p backups
    if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
        echo "skip: $src missing" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    tar -czf "$dest" "$src"
    echo "backed up: $dest"
}

backup_dir config
backup_dir data
exit 0
